reserves.name: Savings claim on rUSD via the Reservoir Savings Module (burn-mint)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Reservoir Protocol and the underlying rUSD reserve basket

reserveReview.rationale: Reservoir's live balance-sheet endpoint listed srUSD as a current protocol liability when reviewed on 2026-09-21. The verified SavingModule fixes the direct relationship: minting srUSD burns rUSD, redemption burns srUSD and mints rUSD, and rusdTotalLiability() includes srUSD supply valued at the module price. The full direct reserve composition is therefore one 100% wrapper claim on the tracked parent rusd-reservoir. The parent's underlying reserve composition and custody risks remain upstream facts.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Reservoir live balance sheet observed 2026-09-21 and verified SavingModule burn-mint relationship
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The direct dependency is fully identified as rUSD. The underlying rUSD reserve composition, strategy allocation, and legal custody terms remain upstream facts tracked on the rusd-reservoir record.
